hb.title: Banners
hb.description: The slides of the home-page hero: a wide photo for desktops and a tall one for phones, a headline, a line of text and a button, in every language of the store. Drag to reorder; switch a slide on when it is ready.
hb.empty: No banner yet. Press “New banner” to create one. Without banners the storefront shows its text hero.

banner.name: Internal name
banner.enabledHint: Off: the slide is kept but not shown.
banner.localesHint: Codes separated by commas; the first is the default (e.g. id, en).
banner.hrefHint: A page of the store (/store, /categories/boards, /custom) or a full https:// address. Empty = no button.
banner.secondaryHrefHint: Optional outlined button next to the first; needs a label per language below.
banner.secondaryCtaHint: Empty = no second button in this language.
banner.scheduleHint: Leave empty to show the slide as long as it is on.
banner.imagesHint: Without images the slide is a dark panel with the text. With one image the storefront uses it for both viewports.
banner.desktopHint: Wide, e.g. 1920 × 800 px. Scaled down to 2400 px wide when larger.
banner.mobileHint: Tall, e.g. 840 × 1050 px. Scaled down to 1200 px wide when larger.
banner.title: Headline
banner.subtitle: Line of text
banner.previewHint: Roughly how the storefront draws it (desktop proportions, default language).
banner.deleteConfirm: Delete this banner and its images?

upload.drop: Drop an image here or choose a file
upload.hint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF, at most {{mb}} MB.
upload.focusHint: Click the point that must stay visible when the image is cropped.
upload.external: Address pasted by hand (not an upload).

errors.invalid_url: The link must be a page of the store (/store) or a full https:// address.
errors.invalid_locale: A text was sent in a language the banner does not have.
errors.invalid_date: Check the dates: the end must be after the start.
errors.invalid_image: Only JPEG, PNG, WebP and AVIF images are accepted.
